titulo: Beau Lamarre-Condon trial: victim’s family cries as double murder trial hears triple-zero call
cuerpo: Court hears audio of call made on morning Luke Davies and Jesse Baird were allegedly murdered by NSW police officer Warning: graphic image below Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A triple-zero call made the morning Luke Davies and his partner Jesse Baird were allegedly murdered has been played to the court as photos of surfboard bags containing their bodies were released. The recording was aired in the New South Wales supreme court on Friday during the double murder trial of former Sydney police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon. Continue reading...
